652         f"""
653         INSERT INTO reporting_agent_profile (
654             agent,
655             first_seen_month,
656             last_seen_month,
657             active_months_count,
658             distinct_store_count,
659             distinct_firma_count,

663             reactivation_count,
664             longest_active_streak,
665             career_total_sales,
666             career_total_quantity,
667             avg_monthly_sales,
668             best_month,
669             best_month_sales,
670             current_status
671         )
672         WITH lifecycle AS (
673             SELECT
674                 agent,
675                 import_month,
676                 total_sales,
677                 total_quantity,
678                 first_seen_month,
679                 is_reactivated,
680                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agent ORDER BY import_month) AS row_num,
681                 { _MONTH_INDEX_SQL.format(alias='import_month') } AS month_index
682             FROM reporting_agent_lifecycle_month
683         ),
684         streaks AS (
685             SELECT
686                 agent,
687                 COUNT(*)::INT AS streak_length
688             FROM (
689                 SELECT
690                     agent,
691                     month_index - row_num AS streak_group
692                 FROM lifecycle
693             ) grouped
694             GROUP BY agent, streak_group
695         ),
696         best_months AS (
697             SELECT DISTINCT ON (agent)
698                 agent,
699                 import_month AS best_month,
700                 total_sales AS best_month_sales
701             FROM reporting_agent_lifecycle_month
702             ORDER BY agent, total_sales DESC, import_month DESC
703         ),
704         store_scope AS (
705             SELECT
706                 agent,
707                 COUNT(DISTINCT site_code)::INT AS distinct_store_count,
708                 COUNT(DISTINCT firma)::INT AS distinct_firma_count,
709                 COUNT(DISTINCT regional)::INT AS distinct_regional_count,
710                 COUNT(DISTINCT asm)::INT AS distinct_asm_count
711             FROM reporting_agent_month
712             GROUP BY agent
713         ),
714         latest_month AS (
715             SELECT MAX(import_month) AS latest_month
716             FROM reporting_agent_lifecycle_month
717         )
718         SELECT
719             lc.agent,
720             MIN(lc.first_seen_month) AS first_seen_month,
721             MAX(lc.import_month) AS last_seen_month,
722             COUNT(*)::INT AS active_months_count,
723             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_store_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_store_count,
724             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_firma_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_firma_count,
725             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_regional_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_regional_count,
726             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_asm_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_asm_count,
727             GREATEST(
728                 ({latest_month_index}) - ({max_month_index}),
729                 0
730             )::INT AS months_since_last_seen,
731             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lc.is_reactivated)::INT AS reactivation_count,
732             COALESCE(MAX(st.streak_length), 0)::INT AS longest_active_streak,
733             COALESCE(SUM(lc.total_sales), 0)::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS career_total_sales,
734             COALESCE(SUM(lc.total_quantity), 0)::INT AS career_total_quantity,

737                 ELSE 0
738             END::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS avg_monthly_sales,
739             MAX(bm.best_month) AS best_month,
740             COALESCE(MAX(bm.best_month_sales), 0)::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS best_month_sales,
741             CASE
742                 WHEN GREATEST(
743                     ({latest_month_index}) - ({max_month_index}),
744                     0
745                 ) >= 2
746                 THEN 'churned'
747                 WHEN GREATEST(
748                     ({latest_month_index}) - ({max_month_index}),
749                     0
750                 ) = 1
751                 THEN 'inactive_recent'
752                 ELSE 'active'
753             END AS current_status
754         FROM lifecycle lc
755         CROSS JOIN latest_month lm
756         LEFT JOIN streaks st
757             ON st.agent = lc.agent
